text:
jordan: Quick weekly pulse for the release train — TL;DR below, please scan and react with :thumbsup: if your team is clear.

maya: thanks! main Q — are we still on track for the regioned rollouts this week?

jordan: yes for NA/EU core, APAC is on a slower cadence due to yesterday's perf flake. see details.

deploy-bot: Canary kickoff: release/train-2026-03-23-3812345678 — canary group A (10%) started on na-west1. Logs: https://ci.redwood/release/3812345678/canary

sam: canary metrics after 30m: throughput +1%, 99p latency +65ms (expected +40ms). errors ~0.2% (baseline 0.05%). sending full dump to #eng-releases-telemetry.

zhen: APAC saw a KV cache eviction storm during the preflight at 02:12 UTC, correlated with a spike in small-batch churn. We're throttling background compaction in apac-prod for now.

linda: noting this as a rollback risk. per runbook, if errors >0.5% for 15m, pause canary and fallback to v2.9.

jordan: action items: 1) sam to watch canary for next 60m and post metrics, 2) zhen to keep throttles in place and checklist for rollback, 3) maya to gate any EU-wide database schema changes until freeze lifted.

maya: got it — tagging infra leads for the DB gating. @linda please start the freeze-exemption form if any urgent migrations needed.

linda: starting exemption form now — use this snippet to request:
```
/rollout-exempt --team your-team --reason "critical migration" --impact "low"
```

deploy-bot: Canary update: na-west1 group A — 45m in. errors 0.28%, 99p latency 70ms. No crash loops detected.

sam: running a narrow diffs test, suspect change in smart-batching heuristics increased tail latency for sub-8-token requests. patch queued (PR #5487).

zhen: APAC remains paused for model-serving lanes; holding regional cutover. If PR #5487 lands and looks good we'll re-run APAC preflight behind a canary toggle.

jordan: decision: continue NA/EU slow rollout, hold APAC. Release freeze for global schema and major infra changes until 2026-03-26 23:59 UTC. Minor fixes (<=2% risk) can go with review and LGTM from release lead.

maya: noted — will update the release calendar and notify partner teams.

linda: if anyone needs a freeze exemption, mention me + provide the command output from the preflight and estimated rollback time.

sam: quick note for SREs — watch for increased crate cache evictions, metric name "kv.cache.evictions" and "batch.tail.latency". I'll post dashboards.

deploy-bot: Canary finished: group A -> PASS (metrics within thresholds) but APAC remains HOLD. Full rollout scheduled: incremental over 8 hours starting 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC for NA/EU.

jordan: thanks all. if you are oncall this weekend and get paging noise from this train, escalate to zhen first. I'll post a short follow-up with the final rollout window. :rotating_light:

maya: cool. will cross-post to #customer-success for any partner-facing messaging.

linda: :white_check_mark:

zhen: on it — keeping APAC blocked until we confirm the heuristics patch helps.

sam: PR #5487 targeting hotfix branch, pinging reviewers.

jordan: end of thread — please react to indicate ack.
